instructions: Follow AGENTS.md and CONVENTIONS.md strictly. Bun only, Cloudflare Workers runtime, GraphQL-only gameplay, session-scoped progression, two decoupled identity systems (server-issued anon_gameplay_session HttpOnly cookie for gameplay with a constant x-session-id same-origin tripwire on mutations, Better Auth cookie for authorship).
ignorePatterns:
migrations/**
scripts/generated/**
src/react-app/routeTree.gen.ts
worker-configuration.d.ts
public/**
dist/**
coverage/**
**/test-results/**
**/playwright-report/**
.wrangler/**

files.description: Project architecture, domain concepts, security invariants

rules.rule: All styling must use CSS Modules. No inline style={} props, no CSS-in-JS.
GraphQL query/mutation strings must be imported from src/shared/gqlQueries.ts. Never define them inline in consumer files.
Every mutation operating on an existing program/gate must call authorizeProgramMutation(db, programId, userId). Never weaken submitGuess's currentGateId desync check (IDOR protection).
Cloudflare Workers runtime - no Node-only APIs (fs, path, process.env directly). No REST gameplay endpoints; GraphQL is the only gameplay API.
Must never be exposed via GraphQL buildSchema().
